info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Payment Initiation API
info.description: The Payment Initiation API facilitates the retrieval of payment initiation details, allowing users to efficiently manage and track their payment requests. This API provides access to essential information related to initiated payments, such as statuses, timestamps, and associated transactions. Typical consumers include bank operators, financial service providers, and developers integrating payment solutions within banking applications. This endpoint plays a crucial role in enhancing user experience through quick access to payment initiation insights.

get.summary: Initiates a payment process for servicing.
get.description: This endpoint is used to initiate a payment related to servicing. It triggers the necessary actions to begin the payment flow for users seeking to manage their servicing payments effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a payment process in the servicing application. It should contain the necessary payment details in JSON format.

200.description: Request completed successfully and payment initiation details retrieved.

InitiatePaymentForServicingRequest.title: Payment Initiation Request Body
